families.title: BTC downside spillover into liquid altcoin perpetuals

source.summary: The cited study reports asymmetric short-run transmission from Bitcoin changes to major alternative cryptocurrencies. AlphaPilot converts that observation into a causal, falsifiable next-bar hypothesis; it does not copy source text or treat the result as a guaranteed trading rule.
source.citation: Katsiampa, Corbet and Lucey, High frequency volatility co-movements in cryptocurrency markets, Research in International Business and Finance, 2019.

families.mechanism: Extreme completed BTC downside moves may be followed by delayed downside adjustment in positively exposed liquid altcoins.
families.formula: BTC return below a prior-only rolling downside threshold; short selected targets at the next hourly open for at most three bars with an ATR stop.

universe.selection: frozen 20-asset fixed core cohort; no historical PIT claim

adaptationLimits: source targets are fixed to ETH, XRP and LTC
adaptation uses the frozen 20-asset cohort only
one lagged beta and volume gate only
